gloss: cut up, cut in pieces, divide by joints
definition: [ נָתַח verb only Pi`el cut up, cut in pieces, divide by joints ( Dr 18 11, 7 ; Late Hebrew id. , Pi`el; rare); — Pi`el Perfect נִתַּח Lev 8:20 , וְנִתַּח consecutive Lev 1:6 ; Lev 1:12 Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיְנַתַּח 1Kgs 18:33 , suffix וַיְנַתְּחֵ֫הוּ 1Sam 11:7 , וַיְנַתְּחֶ֫הָ Judg 19:29 , etc.; — cut up, in pieces , with accusative of animals 1Sam 11:7 , of woman Judg 20:6 (all these to be sent about as token for assembling warriors; on significance of the practice compare RS Sem i. 383; 2nd ed. 402 ); elsewhere usually + לִנְתָחִים , cut up into pieces , of woman Judg 19:29 of sacrificial animals 1Kgs 18:23 ; 1Kgs 18:33 (accusative only), Exod 29:17 ; Lev 1:6 ; Lev 1:12 ; Lev 8:20 (all P ).
